The '''1970–71 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by two points over nearest rival [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]] and [[Cowdenbeath F.C.|Cowdenbeath]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1971–72 Scottish Division Two|1971–72 Second Division]].
